# Lamentations 2 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 2:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | He-bent His-bow like-an-enemy; He-stationed His-right-hand like-a-foe, and-He-killed all [the]-delights-of [the]-eye in-the-tent-of the-daughter-of Zion; He-poured-out like-fire His-fury. |
| LOGOS | He has bent His bow like an enemy, with His right hand set like a foe; and He has killed all who were delightful in our eyes in the tent of the daughter of Zion; He has poured out His fury like fire. |
| PNEUMA | He aimed His bow at us like an enemy. He raised His hand against us like a foe. He killed everyone we held dear. He poured out His anger like fire on the people of Jerusalem. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

## 2:22 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | You-summoned as-on-a-feast-day my-terrors from-every-side, and-there-was-not in-the-day-of YHWH's anger an-escapee or-a-survivor; those-whom I-nursed and-raised — my-enemy annihilated-them. |
| LOGOS | You summoned as if to a festival day my terrors on every side, and on the day of the anger of the LORD no one escaped or survived; those whom I held and raised, my enemy destroyed. |
| PNEUMA | You invited terrors to swarm me on every side — as if calling them to a festival. On the day of the LORD's anger, no one escaped. No one survived. The enemy destroyed every child I nursed and raised. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

| LOGOS | He has cut down in fierce anger all the might of Israel; He has withdrawn from them His right hand in the face of the enemy; He has burned through Jacob like a flaming fire, consuming all around. |
| PNEUMA | In His blazing anger He has cut off all of Israel's strength. He pulled back His hand of protection when the enemy attacked. He blazed through Jacob like a raging fire, consuming everything. |
